title: Composition of finite-level point transports
statement:
Fix a prime $p$, an integer $a\geq1$, $q=p^a$, the field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, and its fixed algebraic closure $k$, the datum of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Fix a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside the chosen algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\geq1$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and $h=\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma):s\to s$, where $\gamma=(z\mapsto z^q)^{-1}$ is geometric Frobenius [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. On the small pro-etale site of $s$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] use the constant ring sheaf $A_s$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], the category $D^b_c(s,A)$ [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], and the point fiber functor $V=\operatorname{Fib}_s$ [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point].

For each $r\geq1$ put $Q_r=L(h^r)^*$, the finite-coefficient derived pullback of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. For $N\in D^b_c(s,A)$ define $\iota_N^{(r)}:V(N)\to V(Q_rN)$ by the finite-level recipe of [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport] with $h$ replaced by $h^r$: restriction along $h^r$, followed by the specified inverse-image colimit insertion and sheafification, then the comparison induced by $x\mapsto x\otimes1$. For $m\geq1$ let $t_m:Q_1Q_m\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_{m+1}$ be the inverse of the canonical composition isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. Then for every $m\geq1$ and $N\in D^b_c(s,A)$,
$$
\iota_N^{(m+1)}=V(t_{m,N})\circ\iota_{Q_mN}^{(1)}\circ\iota_N^{(m)}.
$$
Moreover, for every $r\geq1$ and every derived morphism $u:N\to N'$ in $D^b_c(s,A)$,
$$
V(Q_ru)\circ\iota_N^{(r)}=\iota_{N'}^{(r)}\circ V(u).
$$

source.place: (1.1.7), printed pp. 150-151, transport of structure on the geometric point. The finite derived composition and naturality are the auxiliary refinement of the explicit DAG point-transport recipe needed for the m-th-iterate clause of blueprint lem-trf-frobenius-operator-compact-description; the argument is recorded in report.md.
